controls: Use placement.json and construction.json for legal sites and construction lifecycle variants.
Audit town membership, race, hall level, speed, prerequisites, money, HP, resource mask, day phase, AI and fog in both programs.
Preserve command acceptance/readback, stable creation identities and before-command observation phase.
Repeat each reference twice from independent private profiles; record/replay is an additional control.
Extend horizons through two relevant clock/service events and one tick after completion; never infer absence from a timeout.

cases.input: Observe farm, mine and hall across day wrap, then complete another economy structure.
cases.measure: Clock phase, activation/suspension ticks, resource channels/mask, per-event credits and first harvest after completion.

cases.input: Queue two units in one town and one in another on the same tick; pause and resume only one town.
cases.measure: Acceptance, start/payment and spawn ticks, spawn positions, ordered town-local queues and next-item start.

cases.input: Use task 67 waiting, active and paused cancellation routes, then repeat cancellation after completion/destruction.
cases.measure: Accepted debit and refund ticks/amounts, no duplicate credit, queue and site removal; retain original paid speed/price.

cases.input: Mark damaged ordinary buildings and defences in two towns; cycle repair/off/destroy modes around a service event.
cases.measure: Service event tick, supplied work, ordered target HP transitions, protection, marks and death/occupancy cleanup.

cases.input: Upgrade each reachable hall branch and complete each non-map recipe; save while paused and one tick before completion, then load in a fresh process.
cases.measure: Debit, timer, hall identity/type/HP and build-tree transitions; compare uninterrupted and saved continuations per tick against both reference repeats.
